scope_review.alternative_labels: d025 accepts either complete Lebedeva or Qin evidence set. Named-study questions do not accept other cohorts with similar words. All 32 articles reviewed for relevant overlap.
scope_review.negative_cases: q007, d022-d024: named cohort/report and endpoint/timepoint searched across all selected main PDFs. Lebedeva explicitly excludes dose/form/duration. No supplements ingested. False premises d019-d021 require affirmative source correction, scored separately.
scope_review.category_review: Ten multi-hop cases connect separately located facts; five cross-document cases need facts from both articles. Co-located legacy q005/q018/q019 are lookup cases. q036 and d014-d016 require separate Methods/Results/limitation locations and are multi-hop.
scope_review.duplicates_and_leakage: Repeated article facts test different comparator, false-premise and synthesis scopes; no gold numerical answers inserted in questions. Source-author identity disambiguation is intentional.
source_conflicts: Jan Table 4 OR/CI/P values preserved as printed; no repaired estimate
Dabbs-Brown abstract three male versus Results two male interactions preserved
GQD primary versus sensitivity analysis kept distinct
Guo identification 697/864 versus 697/797 conditional denominators kept distinct
Mbota malformed blood-pressure definition and ambiguous sex shares are not used as validated clinical criteria or prevalence facts

annotation_corrections_after_initial_ret.reason: Source/standards review: four separate-location lookups reclassified multi-hop; distinguish GRADE downgrade reasons per outcome and pathogenic versus adaptive HIF roles. No question, anchor, source or evidence-set change. Original release and retrieval runs preserved. Offline context rescoring only; no score-driven evidence tuning.

scope_review.reference_precision: q005: imprecision is specifically the HbA1c downgrade; FPG/2hPG have small trial count, heterogeneity and methodological limits. d018: mechanistic HIF effects include both adaptive and pathogenic functions; do not label every role harmful.

frozen_cardiology_review.review: All named cohorts/endpoints, accepted alternative sets, decoys, three absent-fact cases and four correction cases checked against additions; none requires changing frozen cardiology gold. Shared mechanism source roles remain query relative. New paired baseline uses a common extended envelope; historical runs remain untouched.

limits: No generated-answer or paid judge run; rubrics untested for answer correctness
Author source review does not certify medical truth or resolve source conflicts
Pinned evidence scoring requires full spans and can be stricter than semantic sufficient evidence
gold_pdf_visual_findings: Inspected all 12 rendered gold pages for drug Table 4 anomaly, gene abstract/Results conflict, quality ratings/identification, non-inferiority margin/CI, syndrome prevalence and renal/sleep mechanisms.
